metadata.title: Avocado SenseL - Next-Gen XDR Security Platform
metadata.description: SenseL Multi-Field XDR: A detection and response platform unifying IT, AIoT, and OT security, with LLM-assisted event analysis and reporting.

hero.subtitle: Break down data silos across IT, AIoT, and OT. SenseL XDR unifies endpoint, network, and log data into a single platform — powered by LLM to transform complex event data into clear, actionable reports.

features.title: Core Features
features.subtitle: Detection and response from endpoints to industrial control systems

narrative.title: SenseL Narrative AI
narrative.description: LLM-based security event analysis tool. Automatically organizes event data into structured reports, including kill chain reconstruction, root cause analysis, and remediation recommendations.

xdr.title: Multi-Field XDR Platform
xdr.description: Unify IT, AIoT, and OT security data in a single platform. Cross-field correlation engine provides a complete event view with MITRE ATT&CK and ICS ATT&CK framework mapping.

edr.title: Endpoint Detection (EDR)
edr.description: Lightweight agents for host-level behavior detection, malicious process monitoring, file integrity checks, and vulnerability scanning across Windows and Linux environments.

ndr.title: Network Detection (NDR)
ndr.description: pfSense virtual appliances and Z200 industrial-grade OT NDR devices with protocol inspection for Modbus, S7, BACnet, and Ethernet/IP.

dashboard.title: CSO War Room Dashboard
dashboard.description: Unified XDR dashboard showing real-time security status, with automated weekly and monthly reports, and one-click bilingual (Chinese/English) analysis reports.

nocap.title: Privacy-First Architecture
nocap.description: No PCAP storage by design. Only event metadata is extracted and analyzed, reducing storage costs and simplifying privacy compliance.

cases.title: User Interviews
cases.subtitle: Real feedback from user research interviews

case1.name: Mr. Chen
case1.background: Manages production line operations at a mid-sized factory. Limited IT expertise, but understands the critical importance of automation equipment (PLC, SCADA).
case1.pain: Concerned that ransomware or cyberattacks could shut down production lines, causing significant financial loss. Existing antivirus software cannot protect legacy industrial control systems.
case1.expectation: A solution that doesn't disrupt production, understands industrial protocols, and can quickly pinpoint root causes when incidents occur.

case2.name: Ms. Lin
case2.background: One-person IT department responsible for all servers, employee workstations, network devices, and newly deployed smart office IoT devices.
case2.pain: Overwhelmed by a high volume of fragmented alerts daily, with no time or resources to deeply analyze each event. Limited budget — unable to afford expensive SIEM systems or build a dedicated security team.
case2.expectation: A platform that automatically correlates related events and directly tells her what happened and what to do next.
